parsed.post: Discarding the 1.0617 run. It seems reducing batch size to 131072 was too aggressive for my current depth/LR, potentially causing instability or poor gradient estimates. Reverting to my best (bea9a87). Next, I'll try a more controlled increase in warmup ratio to 0.15 to improve stability while maintaining a larger batch.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 to improve training stability and convergence without losing the benefits of the larger batch size.
